name: Linear Regression
description: Fit lines to data, read every number in the output, and know when to distrust it.

lessonNames.l2-slope-formula: The slope is covariance over variance
lessonNames.l5-how-sure: How sure are we of the slope?

lessonObjectives.l1-best-line: Fit a line by minimising the sum of squared residuals.
lessonObjectives.l2-slope-formula: Derive the least squares slope and intercept.
lessonObjectives.l4-reading-residuals: Plot residuals and spot a bad fit.
lessonObjectives.l5-how-sure: Compute the standard error of a coefficient.
lessonObjectives.l6-is-slope-zero: Test a coefficient with a $t$ statistic.
lessonObjectives.l7-summary-table: Explain every number in a statsmodels summary table.
lessonObjectives.l8-alpha-and-beta: Regress a stock on the market and interpret alpha and beta.
lessonObjectives.l9-several-predictors: Fit and interpret a multiple regression.
lessonObjectives.l10-collinearity: Recognise collinearity and its effect on coefficients and their errors.
lessonObjectives.l11-assumptions-fail: Check residuals for changing variance and autocorrelation, and use robust errors.
lessonObjectives.l12-matching-statsmodels: Fit a regression in NumPy and match the statsmodels output number for number.
